description: Defines data structures, constants, and functions related to the Precision Time Protocol (PTP) time specification, including timestamp formats and conversion functions, for use in Zephyr OS network stack.

methods.name: net_ptp_time_to_ns
methods.description: Converts a PTP timestamp to nanoseconds relative to the local network clock.

methods.name: ns_to_net_ptp_time
methods.description: Converts a nanosecond timestamp to a PTP timestamp structure.
